crossRefs.note: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep…
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by…
The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of…
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand…
For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.
The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities…
Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the…

translations.web: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
translations.bsb: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
translations.kjv: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
translations.asv: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;
